q: What is the force on the large piston in row 2?
Calculate the missing force in row 3.
Describe how the area ratio affects the output force.
Output force = input force × area ratio (large / small).
In row 4 the small piston moves 10 cm. How far does the large piston move? Explain.
10 × 0.5 / 10 = 0.5 cm: the same volume of liquid moves, so the large piston moves 20 times less; work is not created.
